text: User goal 2026-10-19: the end state must be a simpler, more elegant, better organized and cleaner suite of libraries. Every remaining task is held to: (1) net code shrinks — moves delete originals, no compatibility aliases, re-exports or adapter layers left behind; (2) one owner per concept, no parallel type for something a provider already models; (3) each library has a short README stating what it owns and what it does not, and a dependency list a reader can hold in their head; (4) no new abstraction without at least one real consumer; (5) dead or legacy code met during a move is deleted, not carried. Module-level cleanup: bd-01M59R304VS1D7D2KFA5S3C0XC (docs/plans/module-simplification.md). U6 acceptance should report before/after module, LOC and dependency counts per library.
